description: "Auld Lang Syne" by F. Max Müller is a reflective memoir published in the late 19th century. The author, a prominent philologist and scholar, explores themes surrounding memory and nostalgia, drawing upon his life experiences and notable interactions with friends and contemporaries in the literary and musical realms.
